XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Instrument panel

  • Fault: Fuel gauge not working or malfunctioning; occasionally the gauge freezes at half scale or at zero.
    At the same time, the odometer malfunctions, with an unintended increase in the total mileage displayed.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Malfunctioning instrument panel

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the instrument panel; if necessary, repair or replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, following the repair of the instrument panel, the problem was permanently resolved.
